_comment: Personal @-tag case vectors (maintainer decision HCD-5, 2026-11-21). A personal tag follows the typed case the way a word hotstring does for mot / Mot / MOT, one field per letter: a lower letter types its field as stored, an upper letter types it in capitals (Unicode upper case, so « Prénom » gives « PRÉNOM »). A letter alias is case-insensitive: `n` and `N` name the same field. A named tag (`@iban`, `@IBAN`) names a field, not a letter, and types the value as stored whatever its case. `values` lists the typed fields in order (a Tab separates them on screen); an empty list means the tag types nothing. Synthetic data only. Replayed by the shared rule (tags.lua cased_value) through the Linux manager (linux/tests/unit/hotstrings/engine/dynamic/test_personal_tag_case.lua), the macOS resolver (macos/tests/unit/hotstrings/engine/dynamic/test_personal_tag_case.lua) and the Windows engine (windows/tests/unit/hotstrings/engine/personal/test_personal_tag_case.ahk).
